description.content: Manual client collection generated from platform-bff/docs/openapi.yaml. It covers every public BFF operation (88). Set baseUrl and the test credentials in the companion environment. Send Login first: it stores bearerToken, refreshToken, sessionId and accountId for subsequent requests. Each state-changing request receives a stable Idempotency-Key that is reused if the same Postman request is retried; clear its generated collection variable only when intentionally starting a new logical operation. Populate the remaining IDs and body placeholders with fixture data from the E2E environment; no development credentials or production values are included. Password-recovery and email-delivery operations are present because they are BFF contracts, but require their external email preconditions.
